svg.aria-label: Kubernetes, about 31,000 files. Shorter is faster. Code-only extract: Graphicle 0.1.0, 3 minutes 18 seconds; Graphify 0.9.88, 26 minutes 38 seconds. One run each, Linux, the same 16 CPUs, 8 workers, 14 October 2026. Both built the same graph: 256,329 nodes and 1,400,392 edges.
